, in the range of densities that are relevant to the glass transition, the glass transition is a temperature induced phenomenon, and that temperature and density are not equivalent.

temperature is the control variable, and that it is the temperature dependence of the relaxation times (and not their density dependence) that is the most important aspect of the glass transition.
